description: This file contains unit tests for the SecurePrefs class, which manages secure shared preferences in an Android application. It tests migration of legacy values and persistence of tokens.

classes.name: SecurePrefsTest
classes.description: Test class for SecurePrefs, containing test cases for preference migration and token persistence.

methods.name: loadLocationMode_migratesLegacyAlwaysValue
methods.description: Tests that legacy preference value is correctly migrated to the new LocationMode enum.

methods.name: saveGatewayBootstrapToken_persistsSeparatelyFromSharedToken
methods.description: Tests that the gateway bootstrap token is properly persisted and retrieved separately from other tokens.
